name: mutation-coordinator
body: The session-scoped mutation coordinator process: a short-lived `apg session start` … `apg session end` service that owns the worktree `db.lbug` as sole writer and exposes a Unix socket under `apg/.trans/` for routed mutations. It amortizes one DB open/parse across the session and batches the derived-projection flush at session end. C4 container of the apg CLI system. (Not yet built — its implementation nodes are declared by the plan as planned code.)
